剛好有一批快到期的重置額度要用掉，就想拿來挑戰看看，現在的 AI 到底能不能開發出一款真正可以玩的 3D 動作遊戲？！

於是我就結合了幾個 AI 工具：

- LLM： GPT-6 Astra，協助遊戲程式開發與整合
- 圖片生成： GPT Image、Nano Banana 2.1，負責角色與場景設計
- 3D 模型： Tripo H3.1，將角色圖片轉換成 3D 模型
- 角色配音： ElevenLabs，產生角色對白與配音

再透過 JavaScript 與 Three.js，把角色、場景、戰鬥系統整合成一款真正可以操作的 3D 遊戲！

遊戲取名為 《墨刃 Inkblade》，以鍾馗與中國志怪故事為背景。玩家扮演持劍的鍾馗，深入雨夜古寺與竹林，迎戰墨狼、神秘劍客與山魈，一路闖關揭開村民姓名被奪走的謎團。

最後把遊戲部署到免費的 Cloudflare Pages，不需要安裝，打開瀏覽器就能直接玩，手機也可以！

Photorealistic 3D production challenge,
I created the 30-second 3D video "Lantern River" using only Claude Code (Three.js).

[AI Team Production]
Director: Claude Fable 5.2
Assistants: Opus 5.5 x 5 units
Inspector: Sonnet 5.5

[Tools Used]
- Claude Code
- Three.js (Browser 3D. No assets, all code)
- Running Chrome headless to screenshot one command at a time → converted to video with ffmpeg
- Sound: Stable Audio 3 running on my own PC (music) + Python for synthesis (fire, bell, fireworks, insects, water)
- Did not use any paid image, video, or sound generation
- Graphics board is RTX 3060

[What I Did]
- Wrote design documents and work plans
- Director creates the foundation (world map, camera path, rendering direction, output and inspection tools)
- 5 assistants create parts in parallel (6000 lanterns, water surface and shore, 345 houses, sky and fireworks, music and sound effects)
- Repeated one command 32 to 128 times to render, creating rhythm and pin drops of movement
- Water surface renders by re-rendering the world backwards once more
- Had the inspector who doesn't know the premise watch the still images 4 times, asked "what does the final form look like?", and fixed it based on that
- Made the initial blurry fire and the view of the street lights from above at the end have the same shape
- Full HD, 900-command output takes about 6 minutes. Code is about 5,400 lines
- From starting to write code to completion, took about 2 hours and 10 minutes
